data.one_liner: Check the status of an atRoot server and its atServer for a given @sign.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to retrieve AtStatus objects containing root and server status, an overall AtSignStatus, and corresponding HTTP status codes. It abstracts the lookup logic using the at_lookup dependency.
use_when: You need to know whether an atSign's server is provisioned, running, or activated
You want to display status or handle errors based on server availability
avoid_when: You require real‑time streaming of status changes
You need a full backend client beyond simple status checks
strengths: Simple API for common status queries
Encapsulates enum mappings to HTTP codes
weaknesses: Limited to status checking only, no deeper server interaction
Depends on at_lookup, adding an extra dependency
